description: Angular component for configuring mobile QR code widget settings in Thingsboard UI, including form handling, settings retrieval, and save logic.

classes.name: MobileQrCodeWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing mobile QR code widget settings, extending PageComponent and implementing HasConfirmForm.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, subscribes to settings, and manages form value changes.

methods.name: processMobileAppSettings
methods.description: Processes and applies retrieved mobile app settings to the form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current form settings via the mobileAppService and updates the store if necessary.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for confirmation before exit.
